6.5
rsAggregateInReportLanguageExpression
rsAggregateInReportLanguageExpression is a critical error that will occur when one of the aggregate
functions other than Previous, RunningValue, or RowNumber or a Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup
function is specified within any expression in a Report.Language instance.
